one_liner: CivicState is a watchlist civic-letter workflow with real code and unvalidated demand.
directive: Upgrade the repo soul for VC-grade scrutiny while preserving watchlist honesty.

authority.adoption: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption - operator ruling 2026-06-12; see the PR's POM record

sources: dispatch registry note and scrutiny list
methods: code reality check against planning docs
financial reconciliation using hardcoded pricing and explicit cost assumptions

planningMethod.approach: Use repo files as evidence for product reality; tag all external market, pricing-mix, conversion, provider-cost, and valuation claims as assumptions.
planningMethod.honestyLabels: Every quantitative claim in BUSINESS.md is labeled as evidence or assumption.

thesis.current: US residents may pay for a compliant, citation-backed constituent-letter workflow when it saves research, routing, and drafting work.
thesis.honesty: [assumption: no customer validation found in repo]
thesis.registryConstraint: Watchlist; personal/research asset; not near-term investible until operator confirms business posture.

customer.primary: Individual US residents with civic concerns.
customer.operator: Small operator/admin team reviewing flags, payments, delivery failures, treasury discrepancies, and official-directory issues.
customer.future: Organizations such as HOAs and nonprofits are deferred.

market.tam: $150,000,000/year [assumption: 10,000,000 placeholder potential payers x $15 AOV x 1 order/year]
market.sam: $7,500,000/year [assumption: 500,000 reachable users x $15 AOV x 1 order/year]
market.som: $225,000/year [assumption: 15,000 paid submissions x $15 AOV x 1 order/year]
market.method: Bottom-up scenario math only; no external market data was available in workspace-only mode.

businessModel.pricing: $5, $15, and $25 hardcoded Stripe Checkout tiers [evidence: apps/api/src/routes/payments.ts]
revenueStreams: priority complex review [assumption: mentioned in MASTER_PLAN.md, not implemented]

revenueAssumptions: 500 paid submissions in operating year A [assumption]
3,000 paid submissions in operating year B [assumption]
12,000 paid submissions in operating year C [assumption]
costAssumptions: $6,552 fixed platform/tools cost in operating year A [assumption]
$12,000 fixed platform/tools cost in operating year B [assumption]
$60,000 fixed platform/tools cost in operating year C [assumption]
sensitivityTests: $5 AOV downside makes operating year A revenue $2,500 [assumption]
$3.00 variable cost lowers gross margin to 80.0% at $15 AOV [assumption]
below 1% paid conversion requires very large organic traffic [assumption]
summary: Operating year A revenue $7,500 and operating profit $323 [assumption]
Operating year B revenue $45,000 and operating profit $29,250 [assumption]
Operating year C revenue $180,000 and operating profit $105,000 [assumption]

competition.positioning: CivicState differentiates through cited research, official routing, compliance workflow, and transactional delivery [assumption: not market validated].

holes.hole: Users may not pay for official contact they can do for free.
holes.residualRisk: If conversion is below 1% [assumption], keep as research asset.

holes.mitigation: Use domain warming, bounce thresholds, webhooks, and suppression.
holes.residualRisk: Delivered emails may still be filtered or ignored [assumption].

holes.hole: Local official data may be incomplete or expensive.
holes.mitigation: Evaluate congress.gov, OpenStates, and paid local providers.
holes.residualRisk: Coverage gaps may destroy user trust [assumption].

holes.hole: Citation-backed AI letters may create compliance and reputational risk.
holes.mitigation: Use citation verification, moderation, disclaimers, and human review.
holes.residualRisk: A bad letter or harassment edge case could cause outsized harm [assumption].

strategy.nearTerm: Operator decision, product demo, evidence collection, then market validation.
strategy.defer: Subscriptions, organization API, certified mail, public campaign network, and paid acquisition until core loop is proven.

channels: local civic group referrals after proof [assumption]
goToMarket.firstCustomers: first one hundred customers [assumption: launch target]

operatorWorkflow.review: Admin reviews flagged submissions and can approve, reject, or edit-before-approve [evidence: apps/api/src/routes/admin.ts].
operatorWorkflow.treasury: Ledger and reconciliation workflows exist in worker code [evidence: apps/worker/src/agents/treasury.ts, apps/worker/src/agents/reconciliation.ts].
operatorWorkflow.delivery: Delivery agent sends via Postmark and tracks sent, skipped, bounced, and failed statuses [evidence: apps/worker/src/agents/delivery.ts].

constraints: No network research in this run.
External market claims must remain assumptions.
Operator merge is required for authority.

metrics.conversion: 3% target [assumption: prior plan gate, not validated]
metrics.inboxPlacement: 85% target [assumption: prior plan gate, not validated]
metrics.coverage: official coverage by ZIP [assumption: metric definition]

aiWorkGovernance.citationPolicy: Only cite sources from search results and strip unverified citations [evidence: apps/worker/src/agents/researcher.ts].
aiWorkGovernance.moderationPolicy: Threats block, risky content flags, political viewpoint should not be moderated [evidence: apps/api/src/lib/moderation.ts].
aiWorkGovernance.disclosures: AI disclosure and not-legal-advice posture are required in planning docs [evidence: .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md].

assumptionLedger.evidenceOrAssumption: assumption: willingness to pay not validated

assumptionLedger.claim: Variable cost can stay near $1.25 per job.
assumptionLedger.basis: Modeled AI, email, and payment cost.

assumptionLedger.claim: Compliance workflow can prevent harmful use.
assumptionLedger.basis: Moderation, admin, audit, and citation code.

selfValuation.method: Pre-revenue civic workflow valuation under the $5,000,000-per-business program [assumption: dispatch/program framing].

roadmapGate.reason: Roadmap is now aligned but requires operator ruling and market validation before investible posture.

next: Sourced market research when network is available.
